cave_ranger.text: Ha! A visitor. I've been down here since breakfast looking for a lost glove. It's a very good glove. It had a pocket.

then.text: The tonic's yours, the glove's mine. Keep to the wall on the way out, and give my regards to the daylight.

else.text: Here, take these. Irn tonic, for what ails you, and a tablet for the road. Sweet as a rock, and about as soft.
